summary: The tutorial explains how to use LibreOffice Writer for document editing, focusing on its track changes feature. It demonstrates adding text, comments, and deleting content within a document. The speaker uses LibreOffice Writer version 3.3.4 to edit a document titled "7 Reasons to Adopt Force ODT." Key features include inserting timestamps for changes, highlighting deleted and inserted text, and displaying different colors for each editor's edits. The tutorial shows how to accept or reject changes, revert to previous versions, and view the history of edits. It also highlights the ability to insert comments and delete lines while keeping the original text intact. The document example illustrates multiple deletions and insertions, with timestamps indicating when these changes were made.
